description: A shell script containing tests for Git ref namespace fetch/push functionality, including setup, push, pull, clone, and ref hiding tests.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up initial Git repositories and commits for testing ref namespace fetch/push.

methods.name: pushing into a repository using a ref namespace
methods.description: Tests pushing refs into a namespace and verifies remote refs.

methods.name: pulling from a repository using a ref namespace
methods.description: Tests pulling refs from a namespace and verifies local refs.

methods.name: mirroring a repository using a ref namespace
methods.description: Tests cloning with --mirror and verifies refs are correctly mirrored.

methods.name: hide namespaced refs with transfer.hideRefs
methods.description: Tests hiding refs with transfer.hideRefs during ls-remote.

methods.name: check that transfer.hideRefs does not match unstripped refs
methods.description: Verifies transfer.hideRefs does not match refs with unstripped names.

methods.name: hide full refs with transfer.hideRefs
methods.description: Tests hiding full refs with transfer.hideRefs.

methods.name: try to update a hidden ref
methods.description: Ensures updates to hidden refs are rejected.

methods.name: try to update a ref that is not hidden
methods.description: Ensures updates to non-hidden refs are allowed.

methods.name: git-receive-pack with transfer.hideRefs during advertisement
methods.description: Checks that hidden refs are not advertised during push.

methods.name: try to update a hidden full ref
methods.description: Ensures full refs hidden by transfer.hideRefs cannot be updated.

methods.name: set up ambiguous HEAD
methods.description: Creates a repository with ambiguous HEAD references for testing.

methods.name: clone chooses correct HEAD (v0)
methods.description: Tests that clone with protocol version 0 chooses the correct HEAD.

methods.name: clone chooses correct HEAD (v2)
methods.description: Tests that clone with protocol version 2 chooses the correct HEAD.

methods.name: denyCurrentBranch and unborn branch with ref namespace
methods.description: Tests push rejection and configuration with unborn refs in ref namespace.
